checks.title: Enforce the selected response to risky identities and sign-ins
checks.statement: Apply separate, effective risk controls for user compromise and risky sign-in events.
checks.prerequisites: Risk-policy/log reader; Entra risk licensing and test identity.
artifacts: Enabled user-risk and sign-in-risk Conditional Access policies
Included/excluded users, grant/session controls and licence coverage
Risk event, policy result and remediation/triage record

checks.title: Restrict security-information registration to approved conditions
checks.statement: Protect the initial registration and replacement of authentication factors.
checks.prerequisites: Conditional Access reader; test registration identity and devices.
artifacts: Policy targeting the Register security information user action
Approved bootstrap/recovery process and temporary credential settings
Registration audit events and sign-in context

checks.title: Retire legacy authentication-method policy gaps
checks.statement: Make the current Authentication methods policy the authoritative source for permitted factors.
checks.prerequisites: Authentication-method policy reader; representative test users.
artifacts: Migration state and current method configuration
Per-method targets and exclusions, including passkeys and temporary access passes
Sample registration and sign-in method details

checks.title: Bound application secret and certificate lifetimes
checks.statement: Control application credential creation and expiry while preferring supported secretless authentication.
checks.prerequisites: Application reader; credential standard and test application owner.
artifacts: Secret/certificate start/end dates and owners, excluding secret values
Rotation, expiry alert and workload-authentication records

checks.title: Verify mailbox audit events and bypass exclusions
checks.statement: Record the mailbox actions needed to investigate owner, delegate and administrator activity.
checks.prerequisites: Exchange audit/configuration reader; owner, delegate and admin test identities.
artifacts: Organisation AuditDisabled state and mailbox default/custom audit sets
Known mailbox-action events and searchable retention evidence
